title: 3SUM Hard Problems
exact_target: Can the class of 3SUM-hard problems be solved in subquadratic time? Is 3SUM impossible in $O(n^{2-\varepsilon})$ time for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, even in expectation? The source reports logarithmic improvements below quadratic time in the real-RAM and word-RAM models; these do not resolve this sharper question.
